Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5653 of 2020
Applicant :- Jeetu @ Jitendra And 3 Ors.

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr.
Counsel for Applicant :- Awadhesh Prasad

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Santosh Kumar Mishra Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1776 of 2019 (State Vs. Smt. Jeetu @ Jitendra and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 453 of 2019 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Karvi, District Chitrakoot as well as the charge sheet dated 12.07.2019..

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 1776 of 2019 (State Vs. Smt. Jeetu @ Jitendra and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the Court, learned counsel for the applicants only argued that some direction be issued to the trial court concerned regarding bail as they want to surrender before the trial court.

The application is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the trial court that if the applicants appear before the trial court within 15 days from today and move an application before the trial court, the same shall be disposed of as soon as possible in view of law laid down in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2021) 10 SCC 773 and Brahm Singh and others Vs. State of U.P. and others, 2016 (95) ACC 950.
